_about: Public-domain Alexander Raleigh (1817-1880), Scottish Congregational minister in London (Hare Court, Canonbury), for the Word Hoard: The Story of Jonah the Prophet (1867), Quiet Resting Places (1873 printing), The Little Sanctuary (1873), The Book of Esther (1880), Thoughts for the Weary and the Sorrowful (1882) and From Dawn to the Perfect Day (1883), from Internet Archive scans. Sir Walter Raleigh (1861-1922), the critic, is another man. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 58 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
